items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He sent for Simeon, Omer Simeon.

ctx.x: Later, when I went to work at the Nest Club, then I met Luis Russell. That's when I met Luis Russell. But they were in a while... Then we decided to form a band, a bigger band than he had in the Nest Club. That's when he started enlarging his band, and he sent to Chicago for different ones...the members of King Oliver's band. He sent for Red Allen. He sent for Simeon, Omer Simeon. He sent for Paul Barbarin. The first one he sent for was Pops Foster. I don't know if Pops Foster was in that band or not. But Pops…
Then we left the Nest, and we went I think to the Saratoga Club. That's where Russell got his band together at, with his Chicago boys. That's where... He recorded, he made a recording for...
